answer: Beacon spot-checks with a heartbeat stop fakes. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of identities; each must answer a heartbeat signal proving live compute in 20 blocks or lose its bond. A cedar lives decades on deep roots; a stake surviving checks earns trust, but one silent at its nadir is cut down. Audits return like a comet on a fixed orbit. Forging 100 identities costs 100 machines, $4,000 a month; one honest agent pays $40 once and keeps earning.
